user_request: Automatic roughly ten-second 5–9 point personal monitor calibration, then 5–7 degree margin and sustained distraction timer.

implementation.acknowledgement: Only after GUI paint, visible target and settle; unique pixel digest, fresh timestamp and selected-screen signature required.
implementation.profile: Affine angle-to-screen mapping for validation/display; convex polygon of four measured corner medians for angular boundary distance.
implementation.head: Do not add head pose to CNN gaze ray. Independent measured head pose supplies optional stability checks; known unstable pose rejects capture.
implementation.decision: Inside polygon SCREEN; outside <=6 degrees UNKNOWN/no strike; beyond6 degrees directional. LEFT/RIGHT/DOWN use existing5second rule; UP display only.
implementation.uncertainty: Finite uncertain observations may display a preliminary direction, never a strict gaze strike.
implementation.quality_scope: Engineering heuristics for this prototype, not independently validated statistical accuracy or intent of cheating.
implementation.persistence: Session-local angles only; no calibration images or personal screen profile written to disk.
implementation.display_changes: Invalidate on monitor identity/geometry/DPI changes or exam target monitor mismatch; fresh point calibration required before START/UNLOCK.
implementation.inference: CNN crop, preprocessing, ONNX weights and raw angle estimation unchanged; builder verifies original inference AST.

validation.additional_scope: Native exam monitor selection/recovery, authenticated adaptive gaze event delivery and no-strike controls; added after full-suite collection.
validation.ui: Real Qt synthetic camera flow and independently rendered1280x720 introductory/point views.
validation.native_monitor: Read-only Windows Qt native HMONITOR vs foreground window probe passed; multiple displays/DPI only mocked.

physical_acceptance: Pending actual webcam and user following targets. Synthetic tests, UI rendering, native monitor read-only probes and portable self-test are not physical acceptance.
distribution: Private closed noncommercial hackathon prototype; retained research license notices and source archive bundled. Public download remains0.4.8.
training: No new training, checkpoint selection, test-set use, GPU server or WSL/service changes for this UI/runtime release.
reference_scope: General separation of calibration/validation targets only; no Tobii hardware/SDK or accuracy claim.

publication_redaction.embedded_evidence_hashes_scope: historical original artifacts; a redacted report copy has a different file hash
